episodes.title: The Weaponization of Food — The European Supermarket Hack
episodes.summary: Early Monday, managers at hundreds of French supermarkets opened their freezers to a wave of hot air. Overnight, hackers had taken over the Danfoss software that controls the stores’ refrigeration and told it to heat up.
